pid_file.description: Absolute path where Booth writes its process ID file.

log_file.description: Absolute path to a log file (leave empty to use syslog).

ticket_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) to wait for responses when granting/releasing tickets.

auth.description: Authentication configuration (optional). Leave null to disable auth.

file_path.description: Path to the shared secret file (used with method='file').

key_path.description: Path to the PEM-formatted private key (used with method='key').

tickets.description: List of cluster tickets to manage. Each ticket is a HA resource that can be held by one site at a time.

name.description: Unique name for this ticket (used as identifier).

sites.description: List of site addresses (IPs or hostnames) that may acquire this ticket.

priority.description: Ticket priority (0–255) — higher values win in争用 (tie-breaker).

revoke_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before automatically re-granting a revoked ticket (after failover).

server.description: Configuration for the Booth daemon itself.

enabled.description: Whether to start the Booth daemon (must be true to participate in ticket management).

port.description: UDP port used for peer communication and ticket negotiation.

peers.description: List of other Booth nodes (IPs or hostnames) forming the cluster.

items.description: Peer node address (IP v4/v6 or hostname).
